# Drey Studio

Drey Studio is a website development and digital design studio led by Damilare Olaniyi. It helps businesses turn ideas and business goals into useful digital experiences through website development, UI/UX design, SEO and digital design.

## Key pages and features

- [Home](https://dreystudio.ng/): Overview of Drey Studio's services, work, process and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://dreystudio.ng/about): Studio background, founder information, services and working approach.
- [Services](https://dreystudio.ng/service/service): Overview of the studio's service offering.
- [Website Development](https://dreystudio.ng/service/website-development): Business websites, landing pages, e-commerce websites, custom web applications and redesigns.
- [UI/UX Design](https://dreystudio.ng/service/ui-ux-design): User interface and experience design focused on clarity and usability.
- [SEO & AI Search Optimization](https://dreystudio.ng/service/seo-ai-search-optimization): Search visibility, technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO and AI search optimization.
- [Graphic Design](https://dreystudio.ng/service/graphic-design): Brand and visual design work for digital touchpoints.
- [Work](https://dreystudio.ng/work): Selected project work.
- [Nexus Construction case study](https://dreystudio.ng/work/Nexus-Construction/): A construction website case study covering services, project presentation, and client enquiries.
- [AURA Skincare case study](https://dreystudio.ng/work/skincare-website/): A skincare website case study focused on product presentation, transformations, and brand credibility.
- [IDERA real estate case study](https://dreystudio.ng/work/idera-estate/): A residential real estate website case study focused on property discovery and inspection journeys.
- [Itan Kitchen restaurant website case study](https://dreystudio.ng/work/itan-kitchen/): A restaurant website case study focused on food presentation, menu discovery and ordering routes.
- [TrackPoint logistics platform case study](https://dreystudio.ng/work/trackpoint/): A logistics website and shipment management platform case study focused on delivery booking, tracking and operational coordination.
- [Pricing](https://dreystudio.ng/pricing): Pricing information.
- [Blog](https://dreystudio.ng/blog/): Articles about websites, web design, SEO and related digital topics.
- [Book a consultation](https://dreystudio.ng/book-consultation): Consultation booking page.
